# Vardhaman CricBid

> Cricket auction software for tournament organisers in India. Run an IPL-style
> player auction live: collect player and team registrations, hold the auction
> in a real-time bidding room with per-category budgets and bid increment
> slabs, notify players on WhatsApp when they are sold, and broadcast the
> auction with OBS overlays.

CricBid is used by organisers running local and club cricket tournaments. A
tournament is created by a host, players and teams register through a public
form, and the host then conducts a live auction where team owners bid for
players against a fixed purse. Results, squads and spend are available
afterwards, and each sold player gets a shareable card.

## What the product does

- **Player and team registration** — a public form per tournament, with
  configurable fields, payment QR and payment-proof upload.
- **Live auction room** — real-time bidding over websockets, one auctioneer per
  tournament, per-category squad limits, configurable bid increment slabs, and
  a maximum-biddable-amount calculation that keeps a team able to fill its
  remaining squad slots.
- **WhatsApp notifications** — players are messaged when they are sold.
- **OBS broadcast overlays** — standalone pages designed as browser sources for
  streaming the auction, including a pre-show countdown.
- **Ball-by-ball scoring** — a separate scorer app for matches after the
  auction.

## Pages

- [Home](https://cricbid.online/): what the product does, pricing and FAQ.
- [Live demo](https://cricbid.online/demo): a real auction replayed bid by bid,
  no sign-up required.
- [Guides](https://cricbid.online/guides): short step-by-step walkthroughs of
  every task an organiser performs.

## Notes for agents

- Tournament, auction, registration and overlay URLs are per-tournament links
  meant for the people running or playing in that tournament. They are marked
  `noindex` and are not part of the public documentation.
- The canonical host is `https://cricbid.online` (the `www` host redirects to it).
